benchmarkDenominator.totalDescription: Full-tree inventory: 93 Cargo manifests; 472 Rust test/bench source files; 605 fixture files; 180 fixture shell scripts; 214 generated archive fixtures; 2877 upstream files total plus 11 lane-local focused transport/redirect preservation mappings. Targeted gix-object/gix-ref inventory inspected this run: 205 crate paths; 114 test/fixture paths; 37 Rust integration test source files under tests/; 77 fixture paths; 296 Rust #[test] attributes under targeted object/ref src+tests paths; 25 gix-object tree behavior #[test] attributes. Focused gix-credentials inventory: the full credentials integration target passed 50/50 tests; prompt fallback inspected 18 focused prompt/cascade call sites, and native prompt behavior is mapped. Focused gix-pack thin-pack repair inventory: selected bundle/input/output source and input paths; upstream data::input::lookup_ref_delta_objects passed 4/4 filtered tests; native thin-pack repair behavior is mapped. Focused gix-pack bounded delta-base inventory: selected output entry writer/source paths plus count_and_entries traversal target; upstream data::output::count_and_entries::traversals passed 1/1 focused test with 80 filtered out; native bounded base-candidate, existing-pack output-entry reuse, and legacy REF_DELTA recompression behavior are mapped. Focused gix-merge inventory includes the bounded gix-merge integration target passing 23/23 tests, native text auto-resolution checks for ours/theirs/union, a static text-baseline archive inventory with 512 case lines and 256 physical expected-output files, 24 marker-newline baseline case lines, 16 partial-match baseline case lines, exact mapping for the LF2 merge/diff3 marker-newline outputs, exact mapping for partial-match/merge.merged, the upstream zdiff3 config alias with 46 focused source/test references across 6 selected paths, optional conflict labels plus marker-size byte bounds from 4 selected text-driver paths, built-in merge-driver selection with marker-size attribute parsing from 4 selected platform paths, external merge-driver preparation with 67 focused source/test references across 4 selected platform paths plus 5 directly mapped platform tests, built-in binary fallback with 19 focused source/test references across 4 selected paths plus 3 directly mapped platform tests, external merge-driver injected-runner readback with 12 focused references across 3 selected paths plus 2 directly mapped platform tests, and external merge-driver missing/too-large resource handling with 26 focused references across 3 selected paths plus 2 directly mapped platform tests. Focused multi-head merge-base inventory adds 3 exact upstream octopus test attributes and 14 native PHP checks for sequential, parallel, forked, and criss-cross heads. Focused loose-ref directory blocker inventory adds 1 exact upstream transaction test, 1 focused Cargo pass, and 8 native PHP assertions for empty directory recovery, non-empty blocker refusal, and WordPress tenant HEAD recovery. Focused prepared reference rollback inventory adds 1 exact upstream transaction test, 1 focused Cargo pass, and 20 native PHP assertions for explicit/drop rollback, stale lock cleanup, and WordPress tenant review-ref rollback. Focused prepared reference commit inventory adds 2 exact upstream transaction tests, 2 focused Cargo passes, 24 selected upstream test attributes across the create/update transaction files, and 29 native PHP assertions for prepared lock publication, empty directory blocker recovery, non-atomic partial failure, and WordPress tenant prepared-review commit.
